description: Shows a training run's metrics.json: the scores (mAP, accuracy, loss, ...) and the run's settings, plus per-epoch curves (losses, precision/recall/mAP, learning rate) from the results.csv a YOLO run writes next to it. Wire it to a Training node's 'metrics' output, or to a 📄 JSON File source pointing at any metrics.json (or a folder holding one). Design-time only — submits no Tapis job.

inputs.name: results
inputs.description: A metrics.json file, or a folder containing one.
